claim_level: the dossier PERMITS pole-structure and derivative-sign references plus pitch time-to-double order of magnitude; it FORBIDS quantitative pole-value claims until the full derivative tables are transcribed under declared axis conventions (machine_readable_absence below)

static_pitch_stability.gate_form: at least one open-loop longitudinal eigenvalue with positive real part MUST be present
sources: Culick & Jex in Wolko (ed.), The Wright Flyer: An Engineering Perspective, Smithsonian 1987

pitch_time_to_double_s.gate_form: ln(2)/Re(lambda_max) inside the order band; the VALUE is reported, never asserted to a point
sources: Culick, 'What the Wright Brothers Did and Did Not Understand About Flight Mechanics', AIAA 2001-3385 (pitch instability, time to double amplitude roughly 1/2 second)
pitch_time_to_double_s.band_rationale: order-of-magnitude claim widened by the declared reconstruction uncertainty (derivative reconstruction assumptions; axes/sign conventions per E1.4); the band is a factor ~4 each side of the 0.5-1 s citation range

derivative_signs.gate_form: signs of dM/dalpha (destabilizing, canard configuration with the cg near the wing quarter-chord) and dM/dq (pitch damping from surface plunge) must match

pitch_inertia_iyy_kg_m2.note: reconstruction value; enters the q-dot row scaling only — pole SIGNS are insensitive to it, time-to-double scales as ~1/sqrt(Iyy) near the divergence

machine_readable_absence.finding: the full Culick/Jex longitudinal derivative tables (X_u, Z_w, M_w, M_q ... with axis conventions) are published in AIAA-copyrighted papers and are not openly redistributable as data; only the structure/sign/order claims above are frozen here
machine_readable_absence.follow_on: transcription under license or independent re-derivation from the Ames a2 tunnel data is the sanctioned path to quantitative V-02a levels (owner action recorded in the dossier)

conventions: frd body axes, pitch +M nose-up (frame-conventions-v1); matches the Culick/Jex literature so no sign flips at comparison time
